story.title: Story 3: Turn Construction and Recovery Cascade

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on prior findings SV-03-001 and SV-03-002, the implementor response, and directly touched Story 3 surfaces. The recovery race guard, missing TC coverage, TC-3.7a provider-transaction proof, and TC-3.8d live-work/ready-row behavior are now backed by code and tests. Targeted test, story gate, and epic gate all passed.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: recoverDerivation now updates only rows with state IN ('pending', 'failed') at packages/lhc/src/domains/turns/internal/recovery.ts:69-74, so an already-ready worker result is not overwritten. The new test at packages/lhc/test/turn-cascade.test.ts:251-299 writes 'real worker output' before floor recovery persists and asserts the floor renders while the ready row remains real worker output. The focused ready-row overwrite probe also passed.

Required missing TC evidence was added in packages/lhc/test/turn-cascade.test.ts: TC-3.2c original-source fallback at lines 140-165, TC-3.4a verbatim assistant/thinking/runtime order at lines 301-331, and TC-3.5a multiple not-ready no-hole construction at lines 364-418. The targeted Story 3 test now runs 10 tests and passed.

gatesRun.command: cd packages/lhc && pnpm exec tsx -e "<recoverDerivation ready-row overwrite probe>"
cd packages/lhc && pnpm exec vitest run test/turn-cascade.test.ts

productionPathFindings: No material production-path fake adapter, shim, placeholder, or non-real execution path found on the touched Story 3 surfaces.
